description: The place a fraction (0-1, clamped) of the way along a track is, with its moment rounded to the second: the Photos tab's slider, which runs by distance, so a stop takes up none of it. A track with no length goes by time. Points are { lon, lat, t }, t in epoch seconds.

cases.name: a quarter of the way is halfway through the first leg
past the stop, the second leg goes on from its last moment
three quarters is halfway through the second leg
a track with no length goes by time
